registry.מספר מאגר: kpi:total — database number; used only to collapse rows repeating one database under several addresses, never shown
registry.מזהה בעל המאגר: chart-otypes, chart-abroad, chart-heat, insight:otype — only the legal-entity prefix / length is used to classify the owner; ids never reach the page
registry.שם מלא: chart-owners, kpi:owners, insight:owner — owners are organisations; owners whose details the register withholds are counted, not named
registry.שם המאגר: chart-names — free-text database name, top normalised names only
registry.רחוב: skip: street of the owner's address — address detail, no aggregate story beyond the city
registry.ת.ד: skip: PO box — 80% empty address detail
registry.מיקוד: skip: postal code — address detail; city is used instead
registry.ארץ: skip: 53% empty and 99.9% of the rest is ישראל — carries no contrast
registry.תאריך רישום המאגר: chart-years, chart-recent, kpi:recent, insight:recent, insight:gap, insight:peak — 1900 placeholder dates treated as unknown and disclosed
registry.מטרות: chart-purposes — standard purpose list; free-text ״אחר-…״ purposes counted and disclosed, not shown
registry.קבלת מידע דרך קבע מגוף ציבורי: insight:public_src — 99.5% empty, so an insight rather than a chart
